messages:
laura: Heads-up — seeing sustained p99 serving latency spikes in eu-west dedicated pool since 07:12 UTC, p99 ~1.8s, baseline ~400ms. Errors low but queueing high, customers hitting SLA.
ops-bot: [ALERT] dedicated-eu-west-pool-42 p99 latency breach, threshold 1200ms. CPU/GPU util at 92% on a subset of hosts.
sam: Which pool exactly? any tenants pinned to those hosts?
laura: pool-42, affinity placement applied yesterday for >reserved tenants, but we expect spread. Looks like placement concentrated on host group A.
josh: grabbing profiling traces now. initial look: kernel choice fallback observed during long sequences — many small sequences triggering fallback to slow attention kernel. paste logs:
```
2026-03-18T07:13:21Z serve: trace_id=abc123 kernel_selected=attn_v2_fwd batch_size=4 fallback_reason=kv_miss
2026-03-18T07:13:21Z runtime: kernel_exec_time=220ms (expected 45ms)
2026-03-18T07:13:22Z kvcache: miss_rate=0.48 host=host-A-12 tenant=big-tenant-X
```
miriam: kv cache miss spike matches tenant X's workload + noisy batching. They have a lot of short chats that avoid prefix cache hits. If placement concentrated, KV thrash on host A would cause many misses and kernel fallback.
alex: Also seeing weird quota assignment in the placement service: reserved_quota for big-tenant-X was set to 0.8 instead of 0.08 in the new rollout config. That would allow them to occupy too many slots.
sam: oh — new affinity rollout yesterday was manually patched? who ran that?
laura: @alex rolled the affinity patch as part of edge optimization rollout at 02:40 UTC.
alex: confirmed I pushed a JSON with a misplaced decimal in affinity weights, apologies. That explains concentrated placement.
oncall: immediate mitigation options?
josh: short term: throttle big-tenant-X traffic via routing filter, and enable kvcache-prefetch for their model to reduce misses. I can push a canary kernel param change to force better kernel selection for small batches (prefer fast small-batch kernel) — low-risk.
laura: do it. also re-balance placement to drain host-A-*. Start draining top 3 noisy hosts.
deploy-bot: starting rollout: placement-controller v1.9.3 -> v1.9.4 (drain patch) on cluster eu-west.
ops-bot: throttles applied: tenant big-tenant-X limited to 30% of previous throughput at 07:24 UTC.
josh: profiling after throttle (07:29): p99 dropped to 620ms, kv miss_rate down to 0.12 on drained hosts. Kernel selection stable (attn_v2_fast) for batch_size 2-8.
miriam: good. we should still revert the affinity weight decimal, and add a unit test to placement service to catch weight >1.0 or sum mismatch.
sam: action items: 1) alex revert config and push 7-line fix; 2) josh enable kv prefetch and kernel param canary; 3) infra to re-balance pools and add placment unit test; 4) product to notify affected customers.
alex: submitted revert PR #4021, awaiting review.
laura: timeline: incident detected 07:12, mitigation (throttle + drain) 07:24, p99 mostly recovered 07:29. Recording as Sev2 due to SLA hit.
oncall: tagging for postmortem. Please attach heap/profiler dumps and placement diff to the issue.
laura: attaching initial artifacts to the incident ticket, will follow-up with perf regression graphs. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
